_note: Shared constants. Every script and both models read these values instead of typing them. Values marked TO_CONFIRM must be agreed by the team.
region: PROTOTYPE: 6 CAMELS-AUS catchments in the Richmond and Clarence basins covered by Grafton radar (28)

time.step_convention: hour-ending: value stamped h covers (h-1h, h]

period.status: prototype window; full study can use 2019-2025 (Rainfields3 on NCI starts 2019)

label.rule: 1 if a flood onset at the outlet gauge falls in (issue, issue + horizon]
label.fallback_threshold: 99th percentile of the gauge's hourly level in train years (TO_CONFIRM)

missing.rule: an hour below this fraction is missing (not 0 mm); a sample with any missing hour in its history is dropped

soil.rule: every hour of a sample uses the AWRA-L value of the day before the issue date
